game.title: Faraway
game.subtitle: 远 方
game.tagline: Six years later, the pilot is flying again. Above the sea of clouds there is a hill, and on it everything from the journey is resting.
pause.title: Paused
caption.ruin: Grass has climbed onto its round head and shoulders, and the wind hums low through its hollow joints. No one knows how many years it has sat here.
caption.critter: It has been waiting for you a long time. It isn’t afraid of you.
caption.edge: Beyond this, only the sea of clouds.
settings.title: Settings
credits.fonts: Fonts: Sora, Figtree, Noto Sans SC (SIL OFL 1.1)
caption.arrive: Six years later, you are flying again, and the engine coughs once more. This time you come down on a hill above the clouds. It feels like a place you have seen in a dream.
